name: Tidy Text
description: Cleans up pasted text: single spaces, no empty paragraphs, plain formatting.
author: Doc4Me contributors

macros.name: Single spaces
macros.description: Replaces runs of spaces with one space.

macros.name: Remove empty paragraphs
macros.description: Removes paragraphs with nothing in them.

macros.name: Clear all formatting
macros.description: Takes direct formatting off the whole document; styles stay.
